gpt.text: The Gruul Clans ravage Ravnica's streets while Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to cleanse them, and Ghut Rak plans to bring the guilds back down to earth.
Teysa mocks the Gruul for following Borborygmos, whose only orders are to crush and to eat.
The Izzet goblin Kaluzax is shot down by Gruul while flying an observosphere to bomb Utvara.
